_comment: Used by test_time_window.TestTraceDelayHip. Asserts that no GPU kernel records reach the cached output when ROCPROFSYS_TRACE_DELAY exceeds the workload runtime — proves tool_init no longer starts the SDK contexts when the control session is paused at startup.

validation_queries.description: No kernel_dispatch records should reach the cached output during a TRACE_DELAY window that exceeds the workload runtime
validation_queries.error_message: Kernel dispatch records leaked into the cached trace despite TRACE_DELAY
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM kernels
